scope: One authored Surface enable state and standard Inspectors for current Matrix objects; compact grid runtime details

implementation.surface: Removed the render_enabled Parameter. Construction and ConfigureSurface write NodeMeta.enabled; definitions and manager rows project that metadata. Render capture uses effective_enabled and invalidates stale work. Parameter and metadata changes share one history transaction.
implementation.inspectors: Layer/Layer Group register only Golden child filters. Column/Cell keep the default Inspector. Matrix and child-media adapters keep standard typed widgets, without the removed MatrixRuntimeInspector or runtime prose.
implementation.feedback: Requested/submitted grid markers remain; the grid corner exposes compact status with keyboard-accessible details for requested, observed freshness, renderer, availability, installed, submitted and error state.
implementation.futureColumnGroups: Column Groups are introduced in M12/4, rather than claimed as implemented here. They inherit the same type-agnostic Golden Inspector contract; actual group editing, copy and reload remain mandatory in M12/4 acceptance. No custom Column Group Inspector or duplicate settings form is authorized by this acceptance.

Column Group instances and aggregate control belong to M12/4 and retain that gate's Inspector/edit/copy/reload requirements. M12/3 and all later gates remain unfinished.
